risks.title: Outdated or incomplete IT policies
risks.cause: Unclear policy ownership and missing reviews
risks.event: IT activities follow inconsistent or outdated instructions
risks.impact: Control gaps, inconsistent operations and remediation costs

risks.title: Requirements are not identified or implemented
risks.cause: Incomplete requirements tracking and coordination
risks.event: Applicable requirements are missed or not translated into controls
risks.impact: Compliance gaps, remediation costs and reputational damage

risks.title: Incompatible duties are combined
risks.cause: Insufficient staffing or poorly designed roles
risks.event: A person can initiate and approve incompatible activities
risks.impact: Undetected errors, fraud or unauthorized changes

risks.title: Excessive or inappropriate access
risks.cause: Weak role design, approvals or access reviews
risks.event: Users receive or retain access beyond business need
risks.impact: Unauthorized disclosure, changes or fraud

risks.title: Leaver or mover access remains active
risks.cause: Delayed notifications or incomplete identity lifecycle integration
risks.event: Access is not removed after departure or role changes
risks.impact: Unauthorized access and data exposure

risks.title: Privileged access is misused
risks.cause: Incomplete privileged account coverage and monitoring
risks.event: Privileged users perform unauthorized activities
risks.impact: Data loss, service disruption and weak accountability

risks.title: Weak authentication permits account compromise
risks.cause: Unenforced authentication settings or unsupported legacy systems
risks.event: An attacker gains access using compromised credentials
risks.impact: Unauthorized access and lateral movement

risks.title: Unauthorized or inadequately tested production changes
risks.cause: Incomplete change coverage, testing or approvals
risks.event: A change reaches production without appropriate authorization or validation
risks.impact: Service disruption, data errors and customer impact

risks.title: Emergency changes bypass controls
risks.cause: Broad emergency criteria and missing retrospective reviews
risks.event: Emergency changes introduce defects or conceal unauthorized work
risks.impact: Service disruption and uncontrolled production changes

risks.title: Development and production are insufficiently separated
risks.cause: Legacy architecture and weak deployment permissions
risks.event: Unapproved code or activity reaches production
risks.impact: Data alteration and ineffective segregation of duties

risks.title: Major incidents are not resolved promptly
risks.cause: Unclear escalation rules, response responsibilities or rehearsals
risks.event: A major incident is escalated or recovered late
risks.impact: Prolonged service disruption and customer loss

risks.title: Insufficient capacity or performance
risks.cause: Inadequate forecasting, load testing or alert thresholds
risks.event: Resources cannot support required demand
risks.impact: Failed transactions and unavailable services

risks.title: Batch failures go undetected
risks.cause: Incomplete job monitoring and reconciliation
risks.event: Failed or incorrect batch processing is not detected promptly
risks.impact: Incorrect records, reporting delays and inconsistent balances

risks.title: Backups fail or cannot be restored
risks.cause: Weak monitoring, recovery testing or backup protection
risks.event: Required data cannot be recovered from backup
risks.impact: Permanent data loss or missed recovery objectives

risks.title: Disaster recovery misses business requirements
risks.cause: Outdated impact analysis, limited exercises or insufficient resilience
risks.event: Failover fails or exceeds recovery objectives
risks.impact: Extended interruption of critical services

risks.title: Unremediated vulnerabilities are exploited
risks.cause: Incomplete asset coverage, patch windows or remediation tracking
risks.event: An attacker exploits an outstanding vulnerability
risks.impact: System compromise, data loss or ransomware disruption

risks.title: Malware or ransomware disrupts services
risks.cause: Incomplete endpoint protection or weak segmentation
risks.event: Malicious software spreads or encrypts systems
risks.impact: Service outage, data theft and recovery costs

risks.title: Security incidents are detected or handled late
risks.cause: Missing log sources, insufficient coverage or alert fatigue
risks.event: Malicious activity remains undetected or uncontained
risks.impact: Greater losses and incomplete investigation evidence

risks.title: Social engineering compromises staff accounts
risks.cause: Insufficient awareness training and practical exercises
risks.event: Staff disclose credentials or execute malicious content
risks.impact: Account compromise, malware infection or fraud

risks.title: Sensitive information is disclosed
risks.cause: Weak classification, data handling or protective controls
risks.event: Sensitive information is exposed to unauthorized parties
risks.impact: Privacy harm, remediation costs and reputational damage

risks.title: Poor data quality affects reports or decisions
risks.cause: Inconsistent definitions, weak validation and manual processing
risks.event: Incorrect data enters reporting or decision processes
risks.impact: Incorrect submissions and business decisions

risks.title: Unmasked production data is used in testing
risks.cause: Weak data extraction approvals and masking
risks.event: Sensitive production data enters less protected environments
risks.impact: Unauthorized disclosure of sensitive information

risks.title: Supplier services are disrupted or inadequate
risks.cause: Weak due diligence, service monitoring or exit planning
risks.event: A supplier fails to deliver required services
risks.impact: Business interruption and dependency on an unsuitable supplier

risks.title: Supplier security controls are insufficient
risks.cause: Incomplete security assessment or contractual requirements
risks.event: A supplier weakness enables compromise or disclosure
risks.impact: Supply-chain compromise and data loss

risks.title: Cloud misconfiguration or concentration affects services
risks.cause: Missing configuration baselines and incomplete dependency planning
risks.event: Cloud resources expose data or a shared dependency fails
risks.impact: Data exposure or widespread service interruption

risks.title: Insufficient requirements or testing introduce defects
risks.cause: Schedule pressure and incomplete functional or security testing
risks.event: A release contains material functional or security defects
risks.impact: Business loss, vulnerabilities and rework

risks.title: IT projects miss objectives
risks.cause: Weak governance, changing scope or insufficient resources
risks.event: Projects exceed time or cost limits or fail to deliver benefits
risks.impact: Investment loss and delayed business objectives

risks.title: Assets are missing from the inventory
risks.cause: Incomplete discovery and unrecorded technology adoption
risks.event: Assets remain outside management and security processes
risks.impact: Unpatched systems and monitoring blind spots

risks.title: Unsupported technology remains in use
risks.cause: Incomplete lifecycle tracking and replacement planning
risks.event: Components continue operating beyond supported life
risks.impact: Unremediated vulnerabilities and unavailable vendor support

risks.title: Critical end-user tools lack controls
risks.cause: Missing inventories, ownership and independent reviews
risks.event: An uncontrolled spreadsheet or local tool produces incorrect results
risks.impact: Reporting errors, key-person dependency or data exposure

risks.title: Lost or unprotected endpoints expose data
risks.cause: Incomplete device management, encryption or peripheral controls
risks.event: A lost or misused device exposes sensitive information
risks.impact: Data disclosure and response costs

guides.title: IT policy review
guides.expected_evidence: Policy inventory, review records, approvals and publication notices
guides.test_procedure: Sample policies against the approved review schedule; reconcile approved versions with published versions.

guides.title: Requirements tracking and gap assessment
guides.expected_evidence: Requirements register, applicability decisions, gap assessments and action tracking
guides.test_procedure: Sample newly identified requirements; trace applicability decisions, control gaps and follow-up actions.

guides.title: Segregation of duties
guides.expected_evidence: Conflict matrix, role configuration and approved exceptions
guides.test_procedure: Inspect incompatible role rules; observe conflict prevention and sample exception approvals and reviews.

guides.title: Access request and approval
guides.expected_evidence: Access requests, approvals, role definitions and provisioned access
guides.test_procedure: Sample grants from system exports; verify suitable approval preceded provisioning and granted access matches the request.

guides.title: Periodic access review
guides.expected_evidence: Complete user listings, review sign-offs and removal tickets
guides.test_procedure: Reconcile review populations to system exports; sample review decisions and verify requested removals were implemented.

guides.title: Leaver and mover access removal
guides.expected_evidence: Personnel notifications, integration logs and account status records
guides.test_procedure: Reconcile departures and transfers with account states against approved removal deadlines; inspect failed synchronization follow-up.

guides.title: Privileged access management
guides.expected_evidence: Privileged account inventory, access approvals, session records and reviews
guides.test_procedure: Reconcile privileged accounts with managed coverage; sample access approvals, session monitoring and anomaly follow-up.

guides.title: Authentication controls
guides.expected_evidence: Authentication configuration, password settings and approved exceptions
guides.test_procedure: Inspect authentication settings; sample enrollment and enforcement, then review exceptions and compensating controls.

guides.title: Change approval and risk assessment
guides.expected_evidence: Production change inventory, risk assessments and approvals
guides.test_procedure: Sample production changes; verify risk assessment and authorization preceded implementation within approved windows.

guides.title: Change testing and rollback
guides.expected_evidence: Test results, acceptance records and rollback plans
guides.test_procedure: Sample changes; verify suitable tests and acceptance preceded release and rollback plans address the change.

guides.title: Production change reconciliation
guides.expected_evidence: Change reconciliation reports and unmatched change investigations
guides.test_procedure: Inspect coverage of production activity; sample unmatched changes and verify investigation and resolution.

guides.title: Emergency change review
guides.expected_evidence: Emergency change register, retrospective approvals and review minutes
guides.test_procedure: Sample emergency changes against approved retrospective review deadlines; examine recurring exceptions and trends.

guides.title: Environment separation and deployment
guides.expected_evidence: Network rules, production entitlements and pipeline approvals
guides.test_procedure: Inspect developer production access and deployment approval enforcement; trace sampled releases to approvals.

guides.title: Incident classification and escalation
guides.expected_evidence: Incident records, escalation timelines and reporting records
guides.test_procedure: Sample major incidents; compare classification, escalation and reporting with applicable approved requirements.

guides.title: Monitoring and alert response
guides.expected_evidence: Monitoring coverage, alert rules and response tickets
guides.test_procedure: Reconcile critical services to monitoring coverage; sample alerts and verify timely response and closure.

guides.title: Capacity planning
guides.expected_evidence: Capacity reports, scaling plans and load test results
guides.test_procedure: Inspect report continuity and follow-up on threshold breaches; review load testing for material demand changes.

guides.title: Batch monitoring and reconciliation
guides.expected_evidence: Job logs, exception records and reconciliation results
guides.test_procedure: Sample processing dates; trace failed jobs to alerts and resolution, and inspect reconciliation differences.

guides.title: Incident root cause analysis
guides.expected_evidence: Root cause reports, problem records and improvement actions
guides.test_procedure: Sample major incidents; assess analysis quality and timeliness and verify completion of corrective actions.

guides.title: Backup execution and protection
guides.expected_evidence: Backup policies, job logs, failure alerts and protected copy settings
guides.test_procedure: Verify coverage of critical data; sample failures and reruns and inspect protection of recovery copies.

guides.title: Restore testing
guides.expected_evidence: Restore test plans, results and issue tracking
guides.test_procedure: Check testing against the approved schedule and critical system scope; trace failed restores to remediation and retesting.

guides.title: Disaster recovery exercises
guides.expected_evidence: Exercise plans, measured recovery results and corrective actions
guides.test_procedure: Distinguish actual failover from tabletop exercises; compare measured recovery with approved objectives and inspect issue follow-up.

guides.title: Business impact and recovery objectives
guides.expected_evidence: Impact analysis, critical service inventory and approved recovery objectives
guides.test_procedure: Inspect currency and approval of impact analysis; compare recovery designs with approved time and data loss objectives.

guides.title: Vulnerability and patch management
guides.expected_evidence: Scan results, asset reconciliation, patch records and exceptions
guides.test_procedure: Reconcile scan coverage to assets; sample high severity findings against approved remediation deadlines and inspect overdue exceptions.

guides.title: Endpoint and server protection
guides.expected_evidence: Protection coverage, asset reconciliation and remediation records
guides.test_procedure: Reconcile protected devices with inventory; inspect gaps, protection health and follow-up.

guides.title: Security monitoring and response
guides.expected_evidence: Log source inventory, detection rules and security alert records
guides.test_procedure: Verify coverage of critical log sources; sample high severity alerts and assess response timing and conclusions.

guides.title: Security awareness and exercises
guides.expected_evidence: Training completion, exercise results and follow-up training
guides.test_procedure: Reconcile attendance to required populations; inspect exercise trends and targeted follow-up.

guides.title: Data loss prevention
guides.expected_evidence: Data handling rules, prevention configurations and alert investigations
guides.test_procedure: Inspect coverage of relevant channels and sensitive data categories; sample alerts and review handling decisions.

guides.title: Sensitive data encryption
guides.expected_evidence: Encryption settings, key inventory and key management records
guides.test_procedure: Sample systems and devices; inspect encryption enforcement and key access, rotation and recovery controls.

guides.title: Data quality and reporting checks
guides.expected_evidence: Validation rules, results, reconciliations and approvals
guides.test_procedure: Sample reporting periods; inspect validation failures, reconciliations and approvals for rule changes.

guides.title: Test data masking
guides.expected_evidence: Data extraction approvals, masking records and environment scans
guides.test_procedure: Sample data transfers to non-production; verify authorization, masking and checks for residual sensitive information.

guides.title: Supplier due diligence
guides.expected_evidence: Due diligence reports, risk assessments and approvals
guides.test_procedure: Sample significant suppliers; verify assessments preceded engagement and identified risks have owners and actions.

guides.title: Supplier contract review
guides.expected_evidence: Contracts, review checklists and legal or security review records
guides.test_procedure: Sample agreements against approved service, security, audit, incident and exit requirements; inspect documented exceptions.

guides.title: Supplier performance monitoring
guides.expected_evidence: Service reports, breach follow-up and periodic assessments
guides.test_procedure: Inspect reporting completeness; sample service breaches and assess corrective actions and dependency reviews.

guides.title: Cloud configuration monitoring
guides.expected_evidence: Configuration baselines, coverage reports and remediation tickets
guides.test_procedure: Reconcile accounts to monitoring coverage; sample high risk findings and assess remediation and dependency planning.

guides.title: Project stage reviews
guides.expected_evidence: Stage approvals, project reports and escalation records
guides.test_procedure: Sample projects; verify required reviews, ownership and escalation of material schedule, cost or scope deviations.

guides.title: Secure development checks
guides.expected_evidence: Pipeline settings, scan results, security tests and remediation records
guides.test_procedure: Inspect release gates; sample releases and trace significant findings to fixes, retests or approved exceptions.

guides.title: Asset discovery and reconciliation
guides.expected_evidence: Discovery results, inventory reconciliation and discrepancy records
guides.test_procedure: Compare discovered assets with the managed inventory; sample discrepancies and verify ownership and resolution.

guides.title: Technology lifecycle management
guides.expected_evidence: Support lifecycle inventory, replacement plans and exceptions
guides.test_procedure: Reconcile components to lifecycle records; inspect replacement plans and approved treatment for unsupported technology.

guides.title: Critical end-user tool controls
guides.expected_evidence: Tool inventory, criticality assessments, version records and reviews
guides.test_procedure: Check inventory completeness; sample critical tools for access, change, calculation and independent review controls.

guides.title: Endpoint configuration management
guides.expected_evidence: Device compliance reports, encryption status and peripheral policies
guides.test_procedure: Sample endpoints; inspect required settings and encryption, and verify follow-up for noncompliant devices.
